# WisdomLingo - AI & LLM Context File (llms.txt)
> WisdomLingo is a premier German Language Academy and European Education Consultancy based in Islamabad, Pakistan.

## Academy Overview
- **Name**: WisdomLingo (Wisdomlingo German Language Academy and Consultancy)
- **Website**: https://wisdomlingo.com
- **Core Mission**: Providing end-to-end European pathways including Goethe & ÖSD certified German language courses, tuition-free university admissions, and paid German Ausbildung (dual vocational training) contracts.
- **Headquarters**: House 3A, Park Road, F-8/1, Islamabad, Pakistan

## Key Programs & Offerings

### 1. German Language Courses
- **Levels**: A1 (Beginner) through C2 (Mastery), aligned with CEFR standards.
- **Exam Preparation**: Goethe-Zertifikat, ÖSD, TestDaF, and ECL with mock exam simulations in-house.
- **Instructors**: Certified trainers with native-level fluency. Small batches, interactive speaking focus.

### 2. English & Religious Courses
- **IELTS Preparation**: Band 7+ targeted training across Listening, Reading, Writing, and Speaking.
- **Spoken English**: Accent clarity, workplace communication, and embassy visa interview readiness.
- **Religious Studies**: Quran with Tajweed (Nazra & Hifz), Classical & Modern Standard Arabic, and Persian (Farsi).

### 3. Study Abroad in Europe (Top 6 Destinations)
- **Germany**: 
  - Tuition-free public university degrees (Bachelor's & Master's).
  - 18-month post-study work visa.
  - Complete guidance on APS certificates, blocked accounts (EUR ~11,904), and embassy appointments.
- **Austria**: World-class research universities with nominal fees (~€726/semester) and high visa success.
- **Sweden**: Top 100 global universities with 100% English-taught Master's degrees and post-study residence permits.
- **Switzerland**: Hospitality, business, and tech programs featuring paid internships.
- **Turkey**: High acceptance without IELTS, European-recognized degrees, affordable student living.
- **Cyprus**: Fast-track Schengen-standard degrees with budget-friendly fees and flexible intakes.

### 4. German Ausbildung (Paid Vocational Training)
- **Concept**: 3-year dual vocational training combining employer-paid practical training with state vocational school classes.
- **Monthly Stipend**: €800 to €1,500/month from day one (no tuition fee, employer sponsored).
- **Featured Fields**:
  - IT Specialist (Application Development & Systems Integration)
  - Nursing & Healthcare (Pflegefachmann/-frau) - highest demand & stipend
  - Hotel & Hospitality Management (Hotelfachmann)
  - Painting & Varnishing (Maler und Lackierer)
  - Bakery & Confectionery (Bäcker / Konditor)
- **Requirements**: German language level (usually B1/B2), Matric/FSc/Intermediate, clean record.
- **Post-Completion**: Immediate permanent employment contract and PR eligibility within 21–33 months.

## Proven 4-Stage Pathway
1. **Free Consultation**: Transparent profile evaluation, budget assessment, and personalized destination shortlisting.
2. **Language & Documents**: In-house German/English training alongside certified translations, attestation, APS filing, and motivation letters.
3. **Admission & Finances**: University or employer placement, offer letter securing, blocked account setup, and insurance verification.
4. **Visa & Arrival Support**: Embassy mock interview coaching, appointment booking, pre-departure briefing, and registration/accommodation guidance in Europe.
